qa_pairs.question: How can a user enable GPU usage for an Abaqus standard analysis job when running on a single compute node on Alliance clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: To enable GPU usage for an Abaqus standard analysis job on a single compute node, a user needs to locate the `abaqus` command within their Slurm script and uncomment the line `#gpus=$SLURM_GPUS_ON_NODE`. This option is available for Abaqus 2026 and newer versions.

qa_pairs.question: What are the methods for specifying restart data in the Abaqus input file for a standard analysis simulation?
qa_pairs.answer: In the Abaqus input file, restart data can be specified using two main methods. To write restart data every N time increments, add `*RESTART, WRITE, OVERLAY, FREQUENCY=N`. Alternatively, to write restart data for a total of N time increments, specify `*RESTART, WRITE, OVERLAY, NUMBER INTERVAL=N, TIME MARKS=NO`.
